title: Horizon Imagination: Efficient On-Policy Rollout in Diffusion World Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.08032v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study diffusion-based world models for reinforcement learning, which offer high generative fidelity but face critical efficiency challenges in control. Current methods either require heavyweight models at inference or rely on highly sequential imagination, both of which impose prohibitive computational costs. We propose Horizon Imagination (HI), an on-policy imagination process for discrete stochastic policies that denoises multiple future observations in parallel. HI incorporates a stabilization mechanism and a novel sampling schedule that decouples the denoising budget from the effective horizon over which denoising is applied while also supporting sub-frame budgets. Experiments on Atari 100K and Craftium show that our approach maintains control performance with a sub-frame budget of half the denoising steps and achieves superior generation quality under varied schedules. Code is available at https://github.com/leor-c/horizon-im

translated_title: 视界想象：扩散世界模型中的高效同策略轨迹展开
translated_abstract: 我们研究用于强化学习的基于扩散的世界模型，这类模型具有很高的生成保真度，但在控制方面面临关键的效率挑战。现有方法要么在推理时需要重量级模型，要么依赖高度顺序化的想象过程，两者都会带来高昂的计算成本。我们提出视界想象（Horizon Imagination, HI），这是一种针对离散随机策略的同策略想象过程，能够并行地对多个未来观测进行去噪。HI 融合了一种稳定化机制和一种新颖的采样调度方案，将去噪预算与去噪作用的有效视界解耦，同时还支持子帧预算。在 Atari 100K 和 Craftium 上的实验表明，我们的方法在使用一半去噪步数的子帧预算下仍能保持控制性能，并在多种调度方案下取得更优的生成质量。代码已发布于 https://github.com/leor-c/horizon-im
tldr: 提出视界想象（HI），一种针对离散随机策略、可并行去噪多个未来观测的同策略想象方法，通过将去噪预算与有效想象视界解耦，在仅用一半去噪步数的子帧预算下仍保持控制性能并获得更优生成质量。
en_tdlr: We propose Horizon Imagination (HI), an on-policy imagination process that denoises multiple future observations in parallel and decouples the denoising budget from the effective horizon, maintaining control performance with only half the denoising steps while achieving superior generation quality.
